title: High vacuum dual thruster spinner test, about 2.5 millinewtons

tellings.quote: What we have here is a vacuum test highlighting actual movement in vacuum using a dual thruster pack in the vertical spinner orientation.

plain: A new kind of thruster with no exhaust is said to have produced about 2.5 millinewtons of push, a tiny but measurable force, while spinning on a rig inside a vacuum chamber in Florida. The NASA engineer Charles Buhler, who ran the test, shows Michels a video of 'actual movement in vacuum using a dual thruster pack.' If true, it would mean a craft could move without throwing anything out behind it.
